article.title: Chantilly destination achieved, the Limbourg brothers are amazing
article.excerpt: Commissioned by the Duc de Berry, the enormously wealthy brother of King Charles V of France, this exquisite Book of Hours was begun by the Limbourg brothers, a trio of Netherlandish miniature painters, in around 1411.
